name: Land & General Berhad
overview: 2026年，公司营收和净利润均同比增长，主要由于物业开发业务表现提升。公司宣布派发股息，未披露具体业务板块的扩张、缩减或新合约信息。
overview_en: In 2026, the company's revenue and net profit increased year-on-year, mainly due to improved performance in the property development segment. The company declared dividends, with no specific information disclosed on business segment expansion, reduction, or new contracts.
